data.description: Rowsfred is a driving Tech House track built for the dancefloor. Powered by a tight, punchy groove and sharp percussion, the track maintains constant tensionthrough a solid low-end and precise rhythmic elements. Its dark, modern production and effective drops make it a strong fit for peak-time sets as well as club-focused electronic playlists. A confident, underground-leaning release with clear DJ and crowd impact
data.title: Rowsfred - CLAWN (Original Mix) [Eclipse Records]
